repairs.description: White argues that divine consistency does not require God to repeat every historical act; purposeful, unique action remains possible without its later absence disproving it.
repairs.rationale: Faithfully combines the proposition and inference into a complete, score-blind sentence while preserving White's point about unique divine action.

repairs.description: White argues that defining Gospel as audience-specific historical alteration presupposes inauthenticity, since timeless good news can remain relevant to later believers without redaction.
repairs.rationale: Faithfully captures the definitional objection and its supporting claim that continuing relevance does not require alteration, without introducing evaluative scoring.
